sloka: हेमप्राकारपरिघा यन्त्रशस्त्रसमावृता ।रमणीया पुरी सा हि रुक्मवैडूर्यतोरणा ।। ७.३.२८ ॥
transliteration: hemaprākāraparighā yantraśastrasamāvṛtā ।ramaṇīyā purī sā hi rukmavaiḍūryatoraṇā ।। 7.3.28 ॥

translations.english: That delightful city is indeed equipped with golden ramparts and moats, fortified with machines and weapons, and adorned with archways made of gold and lapis lazuli.
